$comment: Every installable item, and every file of this repository that belongs to none. docs/kit/registry.md describes the format; scripts/registry/pattern-check.test.ts enforces it.

exclude.README.md: this repository's own README; a project's arrives with nothing (AGENTS.md says how to start)
exclude.AGENTS.md: this repository's agent file; a project's is template/AGENTS.md
exclude.CLAUDE.md: this repository's agent file; a project's is template/CLAUDE.md
exclude.package.json: this repository's own; a project's is template/package.json plus each item's package fragment, which the pattern check compares with it
exclude.sdlc.config.json: this repository's own; a project's is template/sdlc.config.json plus each item's config fragment, which the pattern check compares with it
exclude.pnpm-lock.yaml: a project resolves its own on its first install
exclude.registry.json: the registry itself, read by the CLI from the source; never copied
exclude.scripts/registry/: the CLI and the registry's checks; run with pnpm dlx, never copied
exclude.scripts/recipes-check.mts: builds every recipe through add; the registry's own check
exclude.docs/kit/recipes/ui/components.json: what shadcn init -b base -p nova wrote, kept as the record of the flags; in a project shadcn init writes its own

scripts.postinstall: installs this repository's git hooks; a project uses base's prepare instead, which pnpm refuses to run for a package fetched from git (ERR_PNPM_GIT_DEP_PREPARE_NOT_ALLOWED), so this repository cannot have one
scripts.recipes:check: builds every recipe through add (manual: installs)
scripts.registry:check: init, add, diff and update end to end (manual: installs)
scripts.sdlc: the CLI from this checkout; init writes a project's own, pinned to its source
scripts.registry:patterns: prints the registry pattern check's table (it also runs in pnpm test)
scripts.3rdparty: third-party skills: sync <name> re-copies one from upstream and shows what changed; check; link

omit.prepare: pnpm dlx github:… fetches this repository as a git dependency and refuses one with a prepare script; postinstall does the same job here and is merely skipped there

base.description: The process: the kit (docs/kit), the core skills, the hooks and guards, the plan, local CI and setup. Installed by init.

journeys.description: Playwright journeys: three-pass recording with learned masks, one-pass testing, delta, drift and the index.
journeys.notes: Install a browser (pnpm exec playwright install chromium), then write journeys.config.mts and an adapter (tooling/journeys/README.md).

localdb.description: pnpm db:local: a PGlite Postgres per checkout, snapshotted before every migrate or reset.
localdb.notes: Declare databases under localdb.databases in sdlc.config.json (tooling/localdb/README.md).

seed.description: pnpm seed: deterministic mock data, opt-in per app.
seed.notes: Declare each app's seeder under seeds in sdlc.config.json (tooling/seed/README.md).

coverage.description: Merged coverage, per-path floors from sdlc.config.json, and the published report.
coverage.notes: Floors stay unset until there is code; set coverage.floors in sdlc.config.json then.

promote.description: promote:staging, promote:prod, rollback and release: fast-forward only, green local-ci required, smoke-tested.
promote.notes: Declare environments in sdlc.config.json before the first promotion (tooling/promote/README.md).

security.description: security:scan: secrets, dependency audit, licences, install scripts and release age.
security.notes: Install trufflehog or gitleaks for the full secrets scan; without either the built-in patterns run and the step says so.

humanizer.description: humanizer (blader/humanizer): rewrites AI-sounding prose so it reads like its writer, without changing what it says. For READMEs, docs, release notes, PR text and copy.

stripe-best-practices.description: Stripe's own integration guidance (stripe/ai): Checkout Sessions over PaymentIntents, Connect, billing, tax, webhooks, restricted keys. For a project that takes payments through Stripe.

scroll-craft.description: scroll-craft (nateherkai/scroll-craft): premium scroll-driven landing pages, verified on desktop, mobile and reduced motion. For a marketing or landing page that has to stand out.
scroll-craft.notes: Needs Playwright and ffmpeg on the machine. Generating images or video uses kie.ai (KIE_AI_API_KEY), which is paid and receives the prompts; it works without one when the user supplies the media. Its workspace is scrollcraft/ (gitignored).

api.description: The port skeleton: Caller, refusals, invoke (validate, scope, authorize, run), the manifest, a PGlite contract suite.

api-bindings.description: The manifest as an HTTP API with OpenAPI, an MCP server and a typed SDK.
api-bindings.notes: Rename @app/bindings; imports of ../../api/src become @<scope>/api once api is a dependency.

app-tanstack-workers.description: TanStack Start on Cloudflare Workers as apps/web: SSR, server functions over a port, Better Auth, four environments.
app-tanstack-workers.notes: Rename @app/web; fill in wrangler.jsonc once infrastructure is provisioned (README).

external../routeTree.gen: generated by TanStack Router's plugin on the first build

env-schema.description: One Zod schema for a Worker's variables and bindings (apps/web/src/env.ts).

db-drizzle.description: Drizzle + pg through Hyperdrive, one client per request (apps/web/src/db); the default ORM.

requiresBecause.localdb: its migrations are applied by pnpm db:local migrate

db-prisma.description: Prisma 7 + @prisma/adapter-pg through Hyperdrive (apps/web/src/db); the alternative to db-drizzle.

check.skip: an alternative app-tanstack-workers does not use (it is written against db-drizzle); nothing here assembles it

telemetry.description: One span per capability call, an attribute registry, a Workers tracer and a test exporter (apps/web/src/telemetry).

journeys-adapter.description: A journeys StackAdapter for app-tanstack-workers: the built Worker under wrangler dev, localdb through Hyperdrive (e2e/stack.mts).
journeys-adapter.notes: Name it in journeys.config.mts (adapter: "e2e/stack.mts") and set APP_DIR, DB and BINDING at its top.

dev-session.description: pnpm dev:session: a real passwordless sign-in for a seeded account, for curl and Playwright.

requiresBecause.app-tanstack-workers: it signs in to the app's Better Auth

llm-openrouter.description: @scope/llm: OpenRouter by data class (ZDR for real data), a model per role, cost caps, recordings (packages/llm).

authz-oso.description: @scope/authz over Oso Cloud: a Polar policy, local authorization from Postgres, the matrix test (packages/authz).

authz-spicedb.description: @scope/authz over SpiceDB's HTTP API, relationships through an outbox, the matrix test (packages/authz).

ui.description: shadcn on Base UI: tokens, the shell with ⌘K and the role switcher, the five screen patterns (apps/web/src/kit).

external.@/: components shadcn add writes into the app (README § Instantiate)
external.react: installed into the app by shadcn init
external.lucide-react: installed into the app by shadcn init

check.skip: needs an app scaffolded by shadcn init (README § Instantiate)

ui.notes: Run shadcn init and add first (README § Instantiate); the kit's tests run with vitest -c vitest.kit.config.ts.
